faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: If your question is not here, write to us.

items.question: What does the membership include?
items.answer: Your tier's GENESIS modules for your team, with updates and support: software access, not a chip design done for you.

items.question: How is GENESIS priced?
items.answer: Per user. Your tier, the number of users and the term are set in your offer.

items.question: Where does GENESIS run?
items.answer: On your own Linux server, next to your tools. CAD and solver licenses, PDK access and compute stay on your side.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: With a free demo session. Then we agree your tier, your users and your tools.

story.headline: How GENESIS started.
story.intro: GENESIS grew out of our own work: RFIC research on one side, building AI products on the other.
paragraphs: RF ideas take shape quickly. The time goes into the loop around them: simulate, compare, check the layout, repeat. GENESIS runs that loop between your tools, while the engineer sets the goals and makes the decisions.
